English: to know each other and stay in touch
Example Sentence: 친구까진 아니더라도 그냥 알고 지내는 사람.
Sentence Translation: Not quite friends, just people you know and keep in touch with.

English: to click with someone, to communicate well
Example Sentence: 저랑 대화가 잘 통하는 사람이 있었으면 좋겠어요.
Sentence Translation: I hope there's someone I really click with.

English: to wait and see
Sentence Translation: I'll wait and see.

English: to be overwhelmed/frazzled (too busy to think straight)
Sentence Translation: I'm swamped from raising my kid.

English: to stay up all night
Sentence Translation: I pulled an all-nighter studying for the exam.

English: it's been [time] since ___
Sentence Translation: It's been 3 years since I came to Korea.

English: you know.../as you know (reminder of shared info)
Sentence Translation: It's my birthday today, you know.

English: even if/even though (concessive)
Sentence Translation: Even if it's expensive, I'll buy it.

English: even to the point of / as far as (upper limit on a scale)
Etymology: 까지 (until/as far as, extended to abstract scales)
Sentence Translation: There was no need to get angry to that extent.

English: through/via
Sentence Translation: I heard the news through a friend.

English: retrospective past modifier (used to be / was in the process of)
Sentence Translation: It's the neighborhood I used to live in as a kid.

English: to come to / end up ___ing (change of state, not by one's own will)
Sentence Translation: I ended up learning Korean.

English: to quote/report a statement
Sentence Translation: My friend said they're busy.

English: self-questioning ending (I wonder if.../do I really...?)
Sentence Translation: Is this right, I wonder?

English: because busy doing (leads to a negative/hindering result)
Sentence Translation: I was so busy studying that I couldn't get in touch.

English: sentence-final ending giving a reason/background (you see, because)
Example Sentence: 저 오늘 못 가요. 약속이 있거든요.
Sentence Translation: I can't go today. I have plans, you see.

English: since/as things are (softened reason)
Sentence Translation: Since the weather's nice and all, shall we go for a walk?

English: -기 (nominalizer) + 도 (also/even) + verb/adj
Sentence Translation: It's also an easy-to-understand book.

English: I bet.../probably (confident guess)
Sentence Translation: I bet it'll rain.

English: the more..., the more...
Sentence Translation: The older you get, the more health matters.

English: retrospective observation (I noticed that.../from what I saw)
Sentence Translation: I noticed there were a lot of people there yesterday.

English: whether... or... (irrelevant alternatives)
Example Sentence: 비가 오든 안 오든 갈 거예요.
Sentence Translation: Whether it rains or not, I'm going.

English: to have/not have ever done ___ (bound noun 적 = occasion)
Sentence Translation: I've never been (there).

English: when I tried/checked, [I found/realized]...
Sentence Translation: When I tried eating it, it was really spicy.

English: embedded question (whether/what/how...)
Sentence Translation: I don't know what kind of person they are.

English: there's a part of me that wants to... (softer than -고 싶어요)
Example Sentence: 혼자 여행 가고 싶은 마음도 있어요.
Sentence Translation: There's also a part of me that wants to travel alone.
